build_SHAS_segmenter: build a SHAS segmenter instance with a pretrained checkpoint path and GPU enabled
run_SHAS_segment: run the SHAS segment method on an audio WAV file path to get speech segments
run_SHAS_build_segments_dataset: run build_segments_dataset on an audio path to get a batch sampler and dataset
run_infer: run the infer function with wav2vec and SFC models on a dataloader to get frame probabilities
run_pdac: run the pdac algorithm on frame probabilities with max and min segment length constraints
